intersect_sphere: compute ray-sphere intersection distances given rays, origin, and radius using the quadratic formula
intersect_cylinder: compute ray-cylinder intersection distances by projecting rays onto the XZ plane and solving quadratically
intersect_plane: compute ray-plane intersection distances given rays, plane normal vector, and plane distance from origin
intersect_axis_plane: compute ray-axis-aligned plane intersection distances along a specified axis dimension
intersect_voxel_grid: compute ray-voxel grid intersection distances for all three axes relative to a given origin
